items.information:
**PORTUGUESE**
A competição é reconhecida pela Associação Mundial de Cubo Mágico (WCA) e os resultados farão parte dos rankings oficiais.
Teremos premiações (medalhas) para os três primeiros colocados de cada modalidade.
Contamos com a colaboração de TODOS para tornar a competição mais fluida. Portanto, quando solicitado, prontifique-se para ser juiz, embaralhador ou runner.

**ENGLISH**
The competition is acknowledged by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the results will be ranked officially.
There will be prizes (medals) for the first three best results in each event.
We count on EVERYBODY's collaboration to make this competition more fluid. Therefore, when asked, please be ready to be a judge, scrambler or runner.

items.name: Mental Breakdown Germany 2019
items.information:
Mental Breakdown Germany 2019 is the third episode of Mental Breakdown competitions in Germany. 

**Important:** This is not a typical Speedsolving-Competition. Therefore, we do not hold the event "3x3x3 Cube". If you want to solve the classic 3x3x3 Cube competively, you can find other German competitions [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?utf8=✓&region=Germany&search=&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list).

The entrance fee for competitors is 7 Euro for the competition with pre-payment. Since most official events are spread on both competition days, every registration is automatically valid for both days.
